messages:
Morgan: Heads-up: I'm stitching a dependency map for Q3 public beta. Goal: one canonical critical-path we can track weekly. Please reply with hard blockers and any parallelization you can commit.

Juan: Draft list from product side — onboarding pipeline (eng-ml), autoscale/scale-to-zero (eng-runtime), dedicated capacity provisioning (eng-infra), private deploy artifacts + packaging (eng-platform), rollout observability (product/console).

Theo: Add eng-sre for canary controls + runbooks. Also flag Legal for Private-only features early.

Priya: eng-ml: quantization certification and perf validation are top risk. Full suite ~3w. Can do a trimmed "fast-validate" for top 5 models in ~8 business days if infra can provide isolated test GPUs.

Emily: eng-runtime: a low-level scheduler/kernels fix (PR #4920) is currently the gating item for stable autoscaling across tenant pools. CI tests currently failing on fp16 edge-case. If we merge, autoscale latency should be stable for canary.

Alex: eng-infra: capacity request CLOUD-2380 is pending; cloud ops quoted 6-8 business days. If product gives a named customer list we can request prioritization.

Morgan: Proposed critical-path sequence (minimal):
```
1) PR #4920 merged & CI green (eng-runtime)
2) trimmed perf validation for top-5 models (eng-ml)
3) CLOUD-2380 prioritized (eng-infra)
4) packaging + compliance checklist for Private (eng-platform + Legal)
5) rollout observability + canary runbook (product + eng-sre)
```
If 1-3 slip, beta date moves. Where can teams run work in parallel to compress timeline?

Theo: eng-sre can prepare runbooks and dashboards in parallel. We need the exact canary success criteria (p50/p95 latency, error budget) from product.

Priya: we'll kick off the fast-validate tomorrow targeting the top-5 models; asking infra for 5 test GPUs for 5 days to shave ~10 days off.

Juan: product will assemble the prioritized enterprise customer list and canary criteria doc by EOD Thurs.

Alex: I'll escalate CLOUD-2380 and share a reply by Wed AM. CI test quota for runtime PR available next week.

Emily: I'll rebase PR #4920 and re-run CI today; target merge Wednesday if green.

Morgan: Action owners:
- eng-runtime: get PR #4920 merged and tag canary candidate (Emily)
- eng-ml: fast-validate top-5 models; provide perf summary (Priya)
- eng-infra: escalate CLOUD-2380 and enable CI GPUs (Alex)
- eng-platform + Legal: draft Private packaging checklist (Theo)
- product: publish canary criteria + enterprise list (Juan)
- eng-sre: pre-create dashboards and attach runbook (Theo)

Please post date changes here. I'll convert this into a dependency Gantt and drop it into the roadmap doc on Friday. Scheduling a 30-min walk-through Monday 10:00. :calendar: :eyes:

sre-oncall: SRE: confirming we'll add 3 dashboards and alerts (latency, failed requests, slot utilization). Need runbook and exact SLIs attached to the roadmap doc.

Alex: CLOUD-2380 update Tue AM. escalate email will include product customer list.

Priya: fast-validate starts tomorrow; will post interim results in 5 business days.

Emily: CI ran locally; pushing to CI now. will report back here.

Morgan: thanks everyone. I'll post the gantt + dependency table Friday 18:00 and open the Monday sync invite.
